scope: Static independent audit of G3 V1 registered protocol and already executed G1-era 16 Twins pilot treatment states. No new G3 G0C or GPU execution and no assumption new source-group prevalence identical.

primary_blockers.old_data_shadow: 16/16 old real G0 treatment message series sorted received ascending, 15/16 reversing full message list violates non-decreasing received chronology, while Gold remains set-based invariant.
primary_blockers.required: Treat full reversal as out-of-contract exploratory, or restrict to reordering same-received-timestamp ties and verify source_native_renderer/order/G0C Gold for each. Report ineligible counts. Do not treat wrong-chronology SHAM as policy-invariant native valid.

primary_blockers.old_data_shadow: T2_Q1 pilot old accept -> new reject both 2/2 lacked N1B; author swap requires fresh non-supporting validator and full quorum-satisfied states may not have one. G3 stop only global half matched can be met by 10 WAIT while 10 ACCEPT get zero match.
primary_blockers.required: Make explicit two stratum-specific T2 C0Q0 vs C0Q1 matched-neutral-source eligibility thresholds. If core ACCEPT stratum not matched, stop/downgrade that claim rather than pool a large WAIT matched rate.

primary_blockers.issue: Shift of treatment message time starts FROM already-conflicted treatment state: source Gold reject->reject, not old accept/wait->unchanged null. This is within-treatment nuisance, not a no-conflict counterfactual.
primary_blockers.required: Track treatment perturbation invariance as distinct class with its own Gold/original key, never label as N1 Gold unchanged relative old.

primary_blockers.issue: Replicating old candidate vote (same author,block,round) is a duplicate-event pattern that may be invalid under actual event-history grammar although set-count policy Gold unchanged.
primary_blockers.required: Prove source authentic duplicate vote support, event identity and chronology; otherwise mark OUT_OF_CONTRACT.

primary_blockers.issue: G3 V1 asserts standing 106-forward GPU authorization from another conversation; independent reviewer cannot verify that original user consent. G-1 decision also states no permission granted by literature preflight.
primary_blockers.required: Before GPU use obtain authoritative admission receipt tied to fixed 106 plan and actual zero-previous-G3 forwards, and comply with user approval scope; do not treat CPU-Gold-only artifacts as permission.

statistical_new_primary_recommendation: Add signed-logit triple specificity contrast of treatment minus Gold-invariant native-token-count-matched N1B for conflicting_vote (true-vs-false), certificate_action (new-vs-old), evidence_level, clustered by run and split Q0/Q1. This improves on recognition error rate alone and is directly motivated by 4 old pilot triples where N1B itself shifted toward conflict/reject 4/4.
